models.name: CovenantProvision
models.evidence: 13 real references in lib/covenant-engine.ts's evaluateProvision/loadCompanyCovenantData; powers the live Dashboard/Capacity/Simulate pages today. Not being extended for new architecture.

models.name: Permission/PermissionRelationship (solver-native)
models.evidence: lib/covenant-engine.ts routes to the solver-native graph with full-coverage-or-fallback discipline; onboarding UI actively surfaces Permission-based workflows.

models.name: ContractRule
models.evidence: Zero app/ references; real persistence path only invoked by scripts/run-phase-c-compiler.ts. Phase B's own starting draft for the future IR, expected to change under Phase 3A.
models.recommendedGuardrail: Document explicitly (code comment) that this shape is expected to change under Phase 3A.

models.name: Legacy Phase C 11-stage compiler (orchestrator.ts)
models.evidence: Invoked only from scripts/run-phase-c-compiler.ts, never app/. Own validated dangerous-unflagged error rate (25.0%, later 15.625%) never cleared its own <=5% safety gate; explicitly superseded by the 2A-2G substrate.
models.recommendedGuardrail: Add @deprecated JSDoc tag (the exact convention already used on StructuralNode.nodeKey) + a static-analysis import-allowlist test.

models.name: FinancialSnapshot
models.evidence: Zero @deprecated markers anywhere in prisma/schema.prisma (grep-confirmed, zero hits repo-wide). Still the only financial input several real pages/scripts read, but Roadmap explicitly says do not extend pending Phase 5A reconciliation.
models.recommendedGuardrail: Add a schema-level @deprecated comment block + a Phase 5A reconciliation ticket reference in the model comment itself.

models.name: FinancialState/Facility/DebtEvent
models.evidence: Real live write path (onboarding/financials/actions.ts). DebtEvent.sourceLedgerEntryId confirmed NEVER populated anywhere (grep) - a live Invariant #35 violation (competing event logs left to silently diverge, never reconciled).

models.name: LedgerEntry
models.evidence: Real, live UI + real restricted-payment pool math consumer. Narrow scope, unlinked from DebtEvent.

models.name: lib/covenant-engine.ts
models.evidence: Real, fail-closed, extensively tested, live production dependency for Dashboard/Capacity/Simulate. Meant to keep running as-is until Phase 4 replaces what it computes, not what Simulate itself does.

models.name: Phase 2A-2G Contract Evidence Substrate
models.evidence: Independently re-verified real strengths (consistent effective-dating semantics, real occurrence-safe identity post-3F.1.2, real conflict/ambiguity surfacing). Not yet wired to any app/ surface - the real risk is under-wiring, not accidental misuse.

models.name: DocumentNode / persistence.ts
models.evidence: Only 2 DocumentNode rows exist in the entire live database (direct query). Never deletes stale rows on re-extraction (FA-DOCID-02) - low blast radius only because of near-zero real population.
models.recommendedGuardrail: Add a documentId-scoped 'supersede prior extraction' step to persistStructuralNodes before real usage grows on top of the current silently-additive behavior.

models.name: DefinedTermNode
models.evidence: Zero app/ references; real persistence path only exercised by standalone scripts. Also the site of the P0 instrument-isolation defect (see TENANT_INSTRUMENT_ISOLATION_RESULTS).

models.name: Amendment operative-state (operative-state.ts)
models.evidence: Most mature single module per North Star, independently re-verified (correct same-day-conflict detection, null-date handling, retroactive/future resolution). Real defect found (the AMBIGUOUS/MISSING-target false-resolution P0) is a bug to fix within the canonical module, not evidence the module itself is wrong-headed.
models.recommendedGuardrail: The false-resolution P0 (see AMENDMENT_OPERATIVE_STATE_ASSURANCE) should be fixed before this module is trusted as a real safety gate in a later phase.

accidentalExtensionGuardrailStatus.deprecatedMarkersElsewhere: Only Phase 3F.1.2's own @deprecated JSDoc tags on StructuralNode.nodeKey/parentSectionRef
accidentalExtensionGuardrailStatus.recommendedMinimumGuardrail: Apply the same @deprecated JSDoc convention to orchestrator.ts's exported entry point and to FinancialSnapshot in schema.prisma, plus a lightweight static-analysis test (mirroring the existing coverage-audit import-boundary pattern) that fails CI if any file outside an explicit allowlist imports orchestrator.ts's runContractCompiler or writes to FinancialSnapshot.
